newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bonds end listless trade flat, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bonds end listless trade flat, seen steady.

text.p: Finnish bond prices were near static in a quiet Monday market as trading volumes were dented by the Armstice Day holiday in several European countries and the U.S., dealers said.
"It has been an unbelievably quite day. There is really nothing else to say," one bond dealer said.
Dealers said the ten-year yield gap over Germany was not likely to ease from the current 66 basis points in the near term.
The markka was marginally firmer as the mark came off intraday highs. Dealers said DEM/SEK was in focus today.
